== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Hang''' is based on his given name (Ming-Hang).
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on March 2, 2024.
** Was the 27th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 4000 assists in the LPL on July 23, 2025.
** The 21st player to reach 4000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on September 20, 2025.
** The 40th player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
